scope: Batch 10 extraction from the untagged 2012-2013 Planeswalker's Guides to Return to Ravnica (parts 1-3), Gatecrash (parts 1-2) and Avacyn Restored (part 1). Leadership claims are as of each guide's publication (2012-2013 Ravnica / Innistrad), not present-day canon. PRELIMINARY_RESEARCH; targeted, not exhaustive; not owner approved.

claims.subject: niv_mizzet

quotes.quote: Niv-Mizzet, the Firemind, is the original parun of the Izzet League.

claims.summary: Niv-Mizzet is the original parun (founder) of the Izzet League.

claims.subject: niv_mizzet

quotes.quote: Such is the case with the parun and guildmaster of the Izzet League, the dragon Niv-Mizzet.

claims.summary: Niv-Mizzet is guildmaster of the Izzet League (Return to Ravnica, 2012).

claims.subject: trostani
claims.summary: Trostani is the Selesnya guildmaster (Return to Ravnica, 2012).

claims.subject: jarad_vod_savo

claims.summary: Jarad vod Savo is the Golgari guildmaster (Return to Ravnica, 2012).

claims.subject: isperia

quotes.quote: The sphinx Isperia is the current guildmaster of the Azorius.

claims.summary: The sphinx Isperia is guildmaster of the Azorius (Return to Ravnica, 2012).
